why: The small shape inside each figure becomes the big outer shape of the next figure: small circle, then big circle; small rectangle, then big rectangle; small triangle, then big triangle. Figure 4 has a small arch shape inside, so the next figure must be a big arch. Only option 4 is a big arch.
trick: Check if the inside shape of one figure becomes the outside shape of the next.
